name: 拾得武器_竹槍_v1.png
prompt:
Use case: game-asset
Asset type: one dropped-weapon pickup sprite for a 2D Sengoku beat-'em-up
Input images: Image 1 is only the game's painted sprite style reference; do not reproduce people.
Composition/framing: one complete pickup centered in one 256x256 square cell, resting diagonally on the ground and occupying about 70-80% of the canvas. At least 20px clear margin. 
Style/medium: detailed painted anime-realistic 2D arcade sprite, crisp dark outline, cel-shaded highlights, realistic period materials, consistent with Image 1.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid RGB(255,0,255) magenta (#FF00FF), no ground plane or cast shadow.
Constraints: fully visible, physically plausible, one weapon pickup only, no hands/characters, no text/letters/numbers/labels, border, effects, extra items or watermark.
Primary request: a dropped Japanese bamboo spear, practical Sengoku ashigaru weapon. Long straight green-gold bamboo shaft with natural nodes and a narrow, simple forged iron spearhead securely mounted at the upper-right end, with a small iron collar. Lay it diagonally from lower-left to upper-right at realistic infantry length.
Materials/textures: mature bamboo nodes, modest wear, dark forged iron and steel.
Avoid: leaf-shaped fantasy blade, extra decorations, oversized spearhead, glow, sparks, blood.
